id: \rI came all the way from Alola for this vacation. I can't wait to get back home though.
en: \rI came all the way from Alola for this vacation. I can't wait to get back home though.
it: \rSono venuta fin da Alola per questa vacanza. Però non vedo l'ora di tornare a casa.

id: \rOh, are you new? Please enjoy one on the house.
en: \rOh, are you new? Please enjoy one on the house.
it: \rOh, sei nuovo? Prendine uno, offre la casa.

id: \rPlease continue to support us.
en: \rPlease continue to support us.
it: \rContinua a sostenerci, per favore.

id: \rOr...
en: \rOr...
it: \rOppure...

id: \bI always believed in the classics. Here, take one.
en: \bI always believed in the classics. Here, take one.
it: \bHo sempre creduto nei classici. Tieni, prendine uno.

id: \bThose were our only options when I was a Trainer. That or hard work.
en: \bThose were our only options when I was a Trainer.  That or hard work.
it: \bQuando ero un Allenatore avevamo solo queste opzioni. O quello, o il duro lavoro.

id: \rOleana: Are you leaving?
en: \rOleana: Are you leaving?
it: \rOleana: Te ne vai?

id: \rI'm waiting till it's dark to explore the city.
en: \rI'm waiting till it's dark to explore the city.
it: \rAspetto che faccia buio per esplorare la città.

id: \bGalar is home to Dynamax. Rumor has it that the power came from an ancient Pokémon.
en: \bGalar is home to Dynamax. Rumor has it that the power came from an ancient Pokémon.
it: \bGalar è la patria del Dynamax. Si dice che questo potere provenga da un antico Pokémon.

id: \rLiving here isn't easy. There's so much going on it can be hard to keep up with it all.
en: \rLiving here isn't easy. There's so much going on it can be hard to keep up with it all.
it: \rVivere qui non è facile. Succedono così tante cose che è difficile stare al passo con tutto.

id: \bI want to go battle someone.
en: \bI want to go battle someone.
it: \bHo voglia di andare a lottare con qualcuno.

id: \bWelcome to Rose Tower.
en: \bWelcome to Rose Tower.
it: \bBenvenuto alla Torre Rose.

id: \bThis hotel is the height of luxury.
en: \bThis hotel is the height of luxury.
it: \bQuesto hotel è il massimo del lusso.

id: \bI've referred multiple matches for the Champion. He never loses. It's like he's in a league of his own.
en: \bI've referred multiple matches for the Champion. He never loses. It's like he's in a league of his own.
it: \bHo arbitrato diversi incontri del Campione. Non perde mai. È come se giocasse in un altro campionato.

id: \rMime Mime
en: \rMime Mime
it: \rMime Mime

id: \rDo you have your key?
en: \rDo you have your key?
it: \rHai la tua chiave?

id: \rWhere would you like to go?
en: \rWhere would you like to go?
it: \rDove vuoi andare?

en: \rWhere would you like to go?\ch[1,-1,Saffron, Goldenrod,Freezington,Wedgehurst,Exit]

id: \bI collect rare items. I bet I have something you don't have. That's right. It's a Rising Badge.
en: \bI collect rare items. I bet I have something you don't have. That's right. It's a Rising Badge.
it: \bColleziono oggetti rari. Scommetto che ho qualcosa che tu non hai. Proprio così. È una Medaglia Levante.

id: \b...Oh, you went to Johto and got one too? Well, I guess my collection isn't that impressive. You might as well get rid of some of it for me.
en: \b...Oh, you went to Johto and got one too? Well, I guess my collection isn't that impressive. You might as well get rid of some of it for me.
it: \b...Oh, sei andato a Johto e ne hai presa una anche tu? Beh, allora la mia collezione non è poi così impressionante. Tanto vale che tu me ne tolga un po' di torno.

id: \bMaybe I should try collecting friends instead.
en: \bMaybe I should try collecting friends instead.
it: \bForse dovrei provare a collezionare amici, invece.

id: \rWelcome to The Rose of the Rondelands hotel.
en: \rWelcome to The Rose of the Rondelands hotel.
it: \rBenvenuto all'hotel Rose of the Rondelands.

id: \rI'm sorry, the hotel is full due to the upcoming battle in Wyndon Stadium. Please take this as an apology.
en: \rI'm sorry, the hotel is full due to the upcoming battle in Wyndon Stadium. Please take this as an apology.
it: \rMi dispiace, l'hotel è al completo per via della lotta imminente allo Stadio di Wyndon. Accetta questo come scusa.

id: \rI'm sorry, the hotel is full due to the upcoming battle in Wyndon Stadium.
en: \rI'm sorry, the hotel is full due to the upcoming battle in Wyndon Stadium.
it: \rMi dispiace, l'hotel è al completo per via della lotta imminente allo Stadio di Wyndon.

id: \bHi! Sorry about any inconvinience caused by stats not going up in a previous version after using the guy next to me. Bring me any Pokémon that have been affected and talk to me again so I can fix 'em up.
en: \bHi! Sorry about any inconvinience caused by stats not going up in a previous version after using the guy next to me. Bring me any Pokémon that have been affected and talk to me again so I can fix 'em up.
it: \bCiao! Ci scusiamo per il disagio causato dalle statistiche che non aumentavano in una versione precedente dopo aver parlato con il tizio qui accanto. Portami i Pokémon coinvolti e parlami di nuovo, così li sistemo.

id: \bLet me fix up your team...
en: \bLet me fix up your team...
it: \bLascia che sistemi la tua squadra...

id: \b... and done! Enjoy!
en: \b... and done! Enjoy!
it: \b... e fatto! Buon divertimento!

id: \bI'm taking a break before heading back out and exploring.
en: \bI'm taking a break before heading back out and exploring.
it: \bMi prendo una pausa prima di tornare fuori a esplorare.

id: \rOleana: The upper limits of Rose Tower are off- limits.
en: \rOleana: The upper limits of Rose Tower are off- limits.
it: \rOleana: I piani superiori della Torre Rose sono off- limits.

id: \rOleana: Are you ready to meet with Chariman Rose?
en: \rOleana: Are you ready to meet with Chariman Rose?
it: \rOleana: Sei pronto a incontrare il Presidente Rose?

id: \rThe upper limits of Rose Tower are off-limits.
en: \rThe upper limits of Rose Tower are off-limits.
it: \rI piani superiori della Torre Rose sono off-limits.

id: \bRose: Thank you for meeting with me, \PN. I can sense you have a lot of potential. It reminds me of when I discovered Leon.
en: \bRose: Thank you for meeting with me, \PN. I can sense you have a lot of potential. It reminds me of when I discovered Leon.
it: \bRose: Grazie per avermi incontrato, \PN. Sento che hai un grande potenziale. Mi ricorda di quando ho scoperto Dandel.

id: \bWe've both worked hard to get where we are today. I plan to use that success to preserve the very best that Galar has to offer.
en: \bWe've both worked hard to get where we are today. I plan to use that success to preserve the very best that Galar has to offer.
it: \bAbbiamo entrambi lavorato sodo per arrivare dove siamo oggi. Intendo usare questo successo per preservare il meglio che Galar ha da offrire.

id: \bMy point is that you have promise as a Trainer and I'd like to offer my resources to support your battling ambitions. What do you think?
en: \bMy point is that you have promise as a Trainer and I'd like to offer my resources to support your battling ambitions. What do you think?
it: \bIn sostanza, sei un Allenatore promettente e vorrei offrirti le mie risorse per sostenere le tue ambizioni nelle lotte. Che ne pensi?

id: \b... You don't want it?
en: \b... You don't want it?
it: \b... Non lo vuoi?

id: \rOleana: How dare you. Do you have any idea what kind of honor this is?
en: \rOleana: How dare you. Do you have any idea what kind of honor this is?
it: \rOleana: Come osi? Hai idea di che onore sia questo?

id: \bRose: Now, now, \PN is following his own path. I can admire that.
en: \bRose: Now, now, \PN is following his own path. I can admire that.
it: \bRose: Su, su, \PN sta seguendo la sua strada. È una cosa che posso ammirare.

id: \bThank you for your time.
en: \bThank you for your time.
it: \bGrazie per il tuo tempo.

id: \rA Champion, are you? I guess you might need something like this.
en: \rA Champion, are you? I guess you might need something like this.
it: \rUn Campione, eh? Allora forse ti servirà qualcosa del genere.

id: \rThose candies work based on experience over levels. Try using that one on a weak Pokémon.
en: \rThose candies work based on experience over levels. Try using that one on a weak Pokémon.
it: \rQuelle caramelle funzionano in base all'esperienza, non ai livelli. Prova a usare quella su un Pokémon debole.

id: \rMost people don't take the train these days. The Flying Taxi is how most people travel.
en: \rMost people don't take the train these days. The Flying Taxi is how most people travel.
it: \rDi questi tempi pochi prendono il treno. Quasi tutti viaggiano con il Volotaxi.

id: \bI've worked here for over a year. The stuff we're doing is going to change the world.
en: \bI've worked here for over a year. The stuff we're doing is going to change the world.
it: \bLavoro qui da più di un anno. Quello che stiamo facendo cambierà il mondo.

id: \bI like to come here after a long day of battling.
en: \bI like to come here after a long day of battling.
it: \bMi piace venire qui dopo una lunga giornata di lotte.
